title: Mapping the MBE Manuscript to the Package
text: Multi-Component Bayesian Endpoint (MBE) workflow described Lee et al. (2026) two stages: Fit trial-level Bayesian meta-analytic model historical randomized clinical trials. Use draws historical model update treatment effects new trial. package implementation deliberately restricted one clinical endpoint exactly two surrogate endpoints. chronic kidney disease example, two surrogates treatment effects chronic acute eGFR slopes.

title: Mapping the MBE Manuscript to the Package
text: historical dataset either data.table data.frame columns names exactly described .: trial_sim_dat provides shareable simulated example 66 trials. restricted CKD-EPI CT trial data used motivating analysis distributed package.

title: Mapping the MBE Manuscript to the Package
text: historical model can use fixed estimated clinical intercept either half-normal inverse-gamma priors uncertainty parameters. manuscript’s initial specification uses random intercept \beta_0 inverse-gamma priors variance parameters. first simulated trial can held follows: historical_fit contains CmdStan fit, posterior draws, sampler diagnostics. Historical fits accepted checking convergence sampler warnings. historical posterior distribution samples can extracted follows: column names posterior datasets different ’s used manuscript. ’s mapping: historical posterior distribution used prior estimating treatment effect clinical endpoint held-trial.

title: Mapping the MBE Manuscript to the Package
text: held-trial (first row trial_sim_dat) converted naming convention used MBE(), posterior distribution updated using MBE() function. diffuse diffuse_se arguments allow user specify diffuse prior new trial’s surrogate endpoints. intercept0 argument allows user shift mean intercept 0. post_mean post_var mean covariance updated posterior mixture. quantities calculated using weighted sampling method shown Appendix B manuscript. post_psi0 contains resampled posterior draws fixed order clinical endpoint, surrogate 1, surrogate 2. weight_data$norm_w set normalized weights, \{ \tilde{w}^{(b)} \}. importance_diagnostics helps identify whether weights concentrated small number historical draws.

text: repository contains R package accompanying Multi-Component Bayesian Endpoints Randomized Clinical Trials manuscript Lee et al. (2026). package implements MBE exactly one clinical endpoint two surrogate endpoints. current CKD implementation uses chronic acute eGFR slopes two surrogates. code: library(MBE)  data("historical_posterior") data("trial_sim_dat")  # Construct a list for the new trial's observed data, using the first row of the simulated dataset. new_trial <- list(   ClnEst = trial_sim_dat$CE_est[1],   ClnSE = trial_sim_dat$CE_se[1],   Sur1Est = trial_sim_dat$Sur1_est[1],   Sur1SE = trial_sim_dat$Sur1_se[1],   Sur2Est = trial_sim_dat$Sur2_est[1],   Sur2SE = trial_sim_dat$Sur2_se[1],   R1Clin = trial_sim_dat$Cor_CE_Sur1[1],   R2Clin = trial_sim_dat$Cor_CE_Sur2[1],   R12 = trial_sim_dat$Cor_Sur1_Sur2[1] )  # Estimate the posterior distribution of the MBE for the new trial using the historical posterior draws. set.seed(1) fit <- MBE(historical_posterior, new_trial)  # Mean of the posterior distribution for the clinical endpoint, surrogate 1, and surrogate 2. fit$post_mean #>                   [,1] #> clinical   -0.05425464 #> surrogate1  0.67469003 #> surrogate2 -5.04103222  # Corresponding variance matrix fit$post_var #>               clinical   surrogate1   surrogate2 #> clinical    0.01212002 -0.018442933 -0.109817889 #> surrogate1 -0.01844293  0.060857682 -0.005088661 #> surrogate2 -0.10981789 -0.005088661  3.798687086

title: Fit the Historical Model for Exactly Two Surrogate Endpoints — historical_model_fit_2surrogates
text: function fits trial-level meta-analysis model using 2-stage random effects Bayesian model chronic kidney disease (CKD) context first introduced Lee et al. (2026). true treatment effect clinical endpoint \(\theta_i\), true treatment effect two surrogate endpoints \(\gamma_{, 1}\) \(\gamma_{, 2}\) \(\)-th trial, model specified follows: $$\hat{\psi}_i \mid \psi_i \sim N_3(\psi_i, \Sigma_{y, })$$ \(\psi_i = (\theta_i, \gamma_{, 1}, \gamma_{, 2})^T\) true treatment effect vector \(\)-th trial, \(\hat{\psi}_i\) observed (estimated) treatment effect vector \(\)-th trial, \(\Sigma_{y, }\) covariance matrix corresponding \(\hat{\psi}_i\). density \(\psi\) can expressed sequence conditional densities: $$\gamma_{, 2} \sim N(\mu_2, \sigma_2^2)$$ $$\gamma_{, 1} \mid \gamma_{, 2} \sim N(\alpha_{\gamma_1} + \beta_{\gamma_1} \cdot \gamma_{, 2}, \lambda^2_{\gamma_1})$$ $$\theta_i \mid \gamma_{, 1}, \gamma_{, 2} \sim N(\alpha_\theta + \beta_{\gamma_1} \cdot \gamma_{, 1} + \beta_{\gamma_2} \cdot \gamma_{, 2}, \lambda^2_\theta)$$ function fits model using MCMC sampling historical RCTs returns posterior distribution model parameters. loo waic components conditional model-fit measures based manuscript's Stan log-likelihood. distinct explicit internal leave-one-trial-assessment. assessment, call fitting function separately set training trials, omitting held-trial.

Samples posterior distribution \(\gamma_0\) obtained used estimate posterior distribution MBE clinical endpoint using relationship: $$\theta_0 = \alpha_\theta + \beta_{\gamma_1} \cdot \gamma_{0, 1} + \beta_{\gamma_2} \cdot \gamma_{0, 2} + \epsilon, \quad \epsilon \sim N(0, \lambda^2_\theta).$$ Historical posterior distribution \(\alpha_\theta, \beta_{\gamma_1}, \beta_{\gamma_2}, \lambda^2_\theta\) used estimate posterior distribution MBE clinical endpoint without updating distribution.
